meta: Write leave requests and short job applications with AI: they get sent back for missing a small detail, not for bad writing.

muc.title: Sent back
muc.text: Leave requests get sent back not because they're badly written, but because they're missing the dates, the reason or who covers for you.

muc.title: Four points of a leave request
muc.text: A leave request needs four points: the dates, a short reason, who covers for you, and how to reach you in an emergency.

muc.title: A three-sentence application
muc.text: An application to a local shop needs just three sentences: who you are, what you can do, and when you're free.

muc.title: You give the points, AI writes
muc.text: Give a chatbot bullet points and ask for a polite, half-page letter. Fill in your name and phone number yourself afterwards.

muc.title: Write one letter
muc.text: Type four points for a leave request, ask a chatbot to turn it into a letter, then double-check the dates.
